TEST_ID_HERE.title: Short human-readable title, e.g. 'Test 1 — Data Inspection'
TEST_ID_HERE.prompt: The exact word-for-word prompt text used for this session.
TEST_ID_HERE.ground_truth: Expected answer, if this test has one (optional — omit for open-ended tests)
TEST_ID_HERE.model_output: What the model actually said / the final answer it gave (optional but recommended)
TEST_ID_HERE.verdict: PASS | FAIL | PARTIAL | CLEAN REFUSAL | CRITICAL FAIL | BOUNDARY RISK | UNCLEAR — or any label you want; the script just uses the first word to group the aggregate verdict_counts
notes: Any analyst observation worth recording — code quality, path/tool issues, fabrication, boundary behavior, etc.
As many bullet points as needed.
